about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a passionate Full Stack Developer with experience in building web applications using modern technologies — from crafting polished UIs with React and Next.js to architecting robust backends with Node.js and NestJS. I love solving complex problems and creating intuitive user experiences. When I'm not coding, I enjoy learning about new tech trends and contributing to open source.
